scope: 77 complete LAFAN1 clips, physical model v3, release 0.1.1 default parameters

measurement.includes: new process startup, input loading, cold compilation, synchronized IK, CSV/NPZ writes, all-frame physical and source/sphere QA, manifests
measurement.environment_note: Shared workstation: initial overlap with regression tests and ongoing video rendering. This is actual batch wall time, not an isolated hardware benchmark; no repeated-run confidence interval.

limitations: All original 30 Hz frames were physically replayed. Full-trajectory interpolation and continuous collision detection were not performed.
Native physical self-collision uses conservative primitive bodies plus self-only official-foot convex hulls, not every visual mesh triangle.
Zero sampled native self penetration does not imply every frame passes sphere, floor, slip, source-tracking, acceleration, or task-quality gates.
This archive is not sealed or split. Old source datasets, training runs, and sealed manifests were not altered.
